note: Large prairie campground shaded by cottonwoods on the north side of Travers Reservoir, south of Vulcan off Hwy 529: Loops B and C fan across the hillside, Loop A runs down toward the boat basin. Sandy beach, boat launch and rentals, and a concession (daily in July and August, weekends mid-May to September). Water service runs mid-May to mid-September, weather permitting; bring water in the shoulder seasons. The grass is irrigated Monday-Thursday 10-5 in July and August, and gear must be kept off it. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview - keep, marginal, with a caveat; or not waterfront if the reviewer wants named sites): Loops B and C (151 sites) sit on the hillside 300-500 m from the water. Loop A's south end is ~40 m from the narrow dredged boat basin (a road between) and ~90-100 m from the reservoir bay across an open meadow and a marsh fringe; its east side is ~170 m from the east arm with a strip of cottages/marina buildings and grassy slope between. No site is on the water; the shop tags no site 'Near Water'. The stored evidence ('separated from water by paved road + steep eroded drawdown bank') describes the day-use/group area on the west side, not the campground loops. A view of the bay from Loop A's southern sites across the open meadow is likely; nothing names them.
PHONE (stored empty): page 'Information: 403-897-3933' (the tear sheet's 'Little Bow Provincial Park Phone: 403-897-3933'); 'Facility Operator: MIM Management Group Ltd.' Recommend 403-897-3933.
SHOP: 'Closed through Thu Apr 29 2027' (2026 opened Apr 24). No seniors-discount line. Both stored URLs answered.
FIT: many sites are 20-21 ft (23 in Loop A, 26 in Loop B, 47 in Loop C - list in the shop), but each loop has many 31-41 ft sites, so the campground fits.
